_doc: Features pstack relies on. Single source of truth for sync.py markers and for harness profiles (harness/<harness>.md rows are keyed by id).

needs.uses: Install, find, and create skills (project-local, personal, plugin-provided); verification skills are generated into the project.
needs.question: Where does this harness discover project skills and personal skills, and how does a running session pick up a new one?
needs.fallback: Use the harness's project skill directory; tell the user to restart if there is no reload.

needs.uses: Always-applied instructions (user-wide and project) that every session reads.
needs.question: Which file does this harness load into every session, user-wide and per project?
needs.fallback: The project's agent instructions file (AGENTS.md or equivalent).

needs.uses: setup-pstack writes a role -> model mapping (with a budget) that every session loads; arena, architect, swarm, interrogate, how, why, reflect, poteto-mode, and the implementation playbooks dispatch each role on its configured model.
needs.question: How can this harness persist a per-role model choice that every session reads, and honor it when dispatching that role? If no single feature does both, combine others (persistent-rules to store it, model-selection to honor it).
needs.fallback: Only when no combination works: every role uses the parent model; setup-pstack is proposed for exclusion.

needs.uses: Pick a specific model (often a different family) for a subagent, runner, or judge.
needs.question: Can the agent start a subagent or separate run on a named model, and how are models named?
needs.fallback: Run on the parent model; where cross-family judgment matters, use any stronger-model reviewer the harness offers.

needs.uses: Fan out parallel workers, reviewers, explorers, and judges, each with its own prompt.
needs.question: Does the harness have a subagent tool, can calls run in parallel, and what parameters does it take?
needs.fallback: Do the work sequentially in the main thread, one role at a time.

needs.uses: Reviewers and explorers that must not edit files.
cursor: readonly: true on a Task call
needs.question: Can a subagent be restricted to read-only, by parameter or by instruction?
needs.fallback: State 'read-only: do not edit files' in the subagent prompt.

needs.uses: Ask the user a structured multiple-choice question mid-run.
needs.question: Does the harness have a structured question tool?
needs.fallback: Ask in the reply and wait for the answer.

needs.uses: Read past or current chat transcripts (recall, reflect, eval, session pickup, decision-log audits, worktree audit).
needs.question: Can the agent search and read past conversations, and where are they stored?
needs.fallback: Use the current conversation and git history; ask the user for links to prior sessions.

needs.uses: Repeat a task until a check passes, including overnight runs.
needs.question: Can the harness rerun or resume an agent on a schedule or until a condition holds?
needs.fallback: Run the loop inside the session until the check passes or the budget ends.

needs.uses: Hand work to an agent that runs remotely or after the session ends.
needs.question: Can the agent start an independent agent run elsewhere (cloud, new thread, background job)?
needs.fallback: Do the work in this session, or give the user a prompt to start it themselves.

needs.uses: Find and audit git worktrees the harness created.
needs.question: Does the harness create git worktrees, and where?

needs.uses: poteto-mode is a Cursor Custom Mode with its own frontmatter (mode, icon, color, reminder).
cursor: frontmatter mode: true, icon, color, reminder
needs.question: Does the harness have modes, and does it read any of these frontmatter keys with a different meaning?
needs.fallback: Remove the keys; the skill is invoked like any other.

needs.uses: Hide a skill from the model so only the user can start it.
needs.question: Does the harness honor disable-model-invocation (or an equivalent)?
needs.fallback: Keep the key; if ignored, the skill is simply model-visible.

needs.uses: Triage and wait on Cursor Bugbot PR review comments.
needs.question: Does the repository use Bugbot? It is a GitHub app, independent of the agent harness.

needs.uses: Prose naming Cursor as the product the user is in.
needs.question: Does the sentence still hold with this harness's name, or does it describe a Cursor-only behavior?
needs.fallback: Name the harness, or cut the sentence if it only matters in Cursor.

needs.uses: Hand off to skills that ship outside pstack: Cursor built-ins (create-skill, babysit) and other Cursor plugins (cursor-team-kit: deslop, control-cli, control-ui).
needs.question: Does the harness have a skill that does the same job as each companion skill?
needs.fallback: Name the harness skill with the same job; otherwise cut the hand-off and say the skill is unavailable.

needs.uses: Named subagent definitions pstack ships in pstack/agents/ (poteto-agent, Comment Sicko) that skills dispatch by name.
needs.question: Can the harness define named subagents with their own instructions, and where?
needs.fallback: Dispatch a generic subagent and put the role's instructions in its prompt.
